label: SCOTUS (Oyez/Lexis/Wiki)
definition: Directions-LEACE on N SAE decoder rows drawn uniformly from the latents MI scores (training firing rate in [0.02, 0.98]); per seed the mean over 5 draws

audit.probe: L2 logistic regression, one-vs-rest for >2 classes
audit.C_selection: inner 1/5 split of the probe-training data, mean one-vs-rest AUC
audit.fold_aggregation: AUC per test fold, then mean
audit.pairs: matched pairs kept in one fold
audit.constant_coordinates: probe-training SD < 1e-06 x median SD: treated as constant (dropped from that fold's probes)

design.pool: latents with training firing rate in [0.02, 0.98]: the set MI scores (sae_confounder_pipeline.score_confounder_features)
design.draws: 5 per SAE; draw j of seed s, fold f: uniform permutation from default_rng([1000, s, j, 1, f]); budget-N set = its first N latents (nested)
design.draw_mean: rband_mean_n<N> averages the draws within a seed; seeds are the unit
design.mi: mi='auto': MI top-32 as a reproduction check, every budget if the refit SAE does not reproduce the published MI selection
design.sae: protocols.fit_base with the coverage recipe and seed, cached per split

reference_check.note: each batch was checked against the coverage run of its own seeds: seeds 0-2 against the published run, seeds 3-4 against the seed extension's
